description: Images that were built by hand and whose identity existing provider cache keys
were derived from. ci/images.sh pulls them by digest when it can, so that an
architecture restores those providers instead of rebuilding them; when the
pull is refused it builds the images from ../Dockerfile and the keys are new.
A digest here is the identity of one existing image, never a value to edit:
a rebuilt image gets its own tag and digest under the CI namespace.

amd64.source: built in the development sandbox on 2026-11-25 from ../Dockerfile as it was before the multi-architecture change (tags toolchain-wip and runtime-wip); the ids are those of status/images.json there and of the header of ../cache-index.tsv. The workflow's GITHUB_TOKEN cannot pull them: run 45702964185 (2026-11-25) got 'manifest unknown' for the toolchain digest, and provider_cache.py classified the registry's answer for the hand-pushed takx-desktop-proto-cache packages as unauthorized ('docker is not logged in to the cache registry'), so amd64 was built from the CI images under takx-desktop-proto-ci instead. Granting this repository access to those packages (Package settings, Manage Actions access) would let step 1 of ci/images.sh succeed.
